annotations.title: Stablecoin supply: USDC and USDT on 5 networks

description: Live total supply of USDC and USDT on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism and Polygon, read from each token contract (totalSupply), per network and summed per token, plus the grand total. A network whose nodes do not answer is listed with an error instead of failing the call. Use to track stablecoin issuance, liquidity on a chain or mints and burns over time. Example: token=both. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
